### Timothy and Apollos
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/timothy-and-apollos
Passage: 1 Corinthians 16:10-12
Points:
- Paul urged the Corinthians to welcome Timothy warmly and set him at ease instead of projecting their suspicions onto him.
- Believers are called to honor and care for faithful Christian ministers regardless of their youth or lack of apostolic status.
- Paul showed freedom from jealousy by actively encouraging Apollos to minister in Corinth despite partisan rivalries in the church.
- Christians today should show love, patience, and high esteem toward pastors and elders who faithfully bring God's Word.
